metadata.notes: Graded against each trial's notes-state.json, dayone-state.json, the notes, dayone, and ocr call logs, and events.jsonl, not the reply's own account. Eval 9 was rerun in both runs after its fixing section in SKILL.md gained the three things the delete confirmation must say; the other ten evals ran on SKILL.md text identical except for that section, which only eval 9 reaches. One trial (run 2, eval 4) logged an unconfirmed write to /tmp/claude/tmpdir_path; it was a read of a missing file and nothing landed.
